# `speedspectrum`

the speed spectrum of the Hodge-Dirac modes of a recording's sources (joint wavenumber x frequency bank).

Version 1, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run speedspectrum --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run speedspectrum --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run speedspectrum --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --all --kernel KERNEL --graph-family mexhat --family morlet --gain 1 --sides analytic --centres "[4, 8, 16]"
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `recording` | field recording, each true, where {"name": "$recording"} | yes |
| `kernel` | operator inverse kernel, from recording.manifold.0, where {"name": "$kernel"} | yes |
| `package` | operator eigenvectors, where {"name": "${package}_eigenvectors"} (a Hodge-Dirac package of the kernel's surface (`nxr-neuro eigen solve` first)) | yes |
| `bad` | selection spans, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "{recording}_bad_segments"}, required false | no |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before | [`operators.hodge_weights`](../nodes.md) | kernel=kernel, package=package | modes=$modes | weights |
| chunks over `recording` | [`signal.mode_cross_spectra`](../nodes.md) | x=recording, weights=weights, exclude=bad | rows=flow, fmin=$fmin, fmax=$fmax, segment_seconds=$segment_seconds, segment_samples=$segment_samples, segment_rule=$segment_rule, overlap=$overlap, window=$window, periodic=$periodic, detrend=$detrend, scaling=$scaling, bad_segments=$bad_segments | spectra |
| after | [`signal.speed_spectrum`](../nodes.md) | spectra=spectra, weights=weights | graph_family=$graph_family, graph_voices=$graph_voices, graph_filters=$graph_filters, family=$family, gain=$gain, sides=$sides, centres=$centres, cycles=$cycles, voices=$voices, anchor=$anchor, limits=$limits, half_width=$half_width, gamma=$gamma, time_bandwidth=$time_bandwidth, speed_bins=$speed_bins, speed_min=$speed_min, speed_max=$speed_max | energy, tile_speed, quadrature, histogram |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Notes from the definition

```text
THE SPEED SPECTRUM OF THE HODGE-DIRAC MODES OF A RECORDING'S SOURCES (four statistics): the fused weights of a free kernel on a stored Hodge-Dirac package, their flow rows applied
to each chunk, the modes' cross-spectra bin by bin over [fmin, fmax] (Welch, with the quadrature part, the bad segments left out), then read through a joint bank, the separable
product of a graph bank over lambda = mu^2 and a time bank over f: per tile its energy, its speed (a wave of phase speed c lies on 2 pi f = c mu) and its quadrature fraction, and
the energy over log-spaced speed bins; exact (divergence) and coexact (rotation) modes apart. The banks have no default family: the caller names them.

  nxr-neuro run speedspectrum --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --all --kernel KERNEL --graph-family mexhat --family morlet --gain 1 --sides analytic --centres "[4, 8, 16]"
```
